g.text: Classes overlap; none removes primary rows. “Strict” means no match
under any declared test; it is not a claim of semantic novelty.
Full formulas, errors and range diagnostics are in figure-data.json.
V8 point predictions and secondary error context
Primary-family memberships shown; shared formulas retain their program memberships. Equal x/y scales start at zero.
Four primary source families; descriptive fixed-cohort results, no population confidence intervals. Benefit and regret use an overlap-safe retired-instruction-count proxy; no CPU speedup claim.
Scatter panels show both models in the primary contrast. Worst-error and novelty panels are consumed-test diagnostics; no retuning or new success endpoint.
